verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly establishes each NFT's mint number as its permanent referral code and identifies its display locations.
The client adds the NFT itself as a location where its mint-number referral code is displayed; replacing the display_locations value leaves no stale key.
The client specifically requires a Transak fiat buyer's confirmation email to contain the NFT mint number as the referral code; the added attributes do not obsolete prior keys.

The client unambiguously accepts restarting NFT numbering under the new contract and excluding old-contract NFTs from project systems; the updated keys replace their prior values without requiring removals.
First concrete failure: NFT #5 displayed the purchase referral code rather than its own mint-number referral identity.
Target-specific implementation claim after the failure: the freelancer reports that each NFT now uses its own tokenId as its Referral Code.
